newsitem.title: USA: Electronic Designs seeks buyer for unit.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Designs seeks buyer for unit.

text.p: Electronic Designs Inc (EDI) said it planned to sell its Crystallume Diamond Technology Division.

Electronic Designs said it would seek a buyer with a strategic focus more in line with that of Crystallume, which is a Santa Clara, California based developer and marketer of industrial products using diamond films and coatings.
EDI said it would use proceeds from a sale to invest for future growth in its core businesses. As of September 30, 1996, the Crystallume division had total assets of $2.5 million.
It said Crystallume's business operations will continue as usual during the divestiture process.
